lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Al4Co4Si4 (reduced formula AlCoSi) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 194), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Al and Si center has 12 geometric neighbors (4 Al/8 Co, or 8 Al/4 Co, respectively), while each Co center has 12 neighbors (4 Al/4 Co/4 Si), all at distances near 2.62 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Al–Al and Co–Co 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners and edges, while Al–Si pairs share corners.
